ballotQuestion: To maintain quality academic facilities at Los Gatos High School and Saratoga High School by replacing leaky roofs and failing restrooms, plumbing, electrical, heating/ cooling systems; improving school safety; updating, repairing and equipping schools including science, technology, engineering, arts, math, robotics, and career/ college readiness classrooms/ labs; shall Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District's measure be adopted, authorizing $321,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying approximately $30 per $100,000 assessed value ($23,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, with oversight, annual audits, and local control?

alreadyFilled.plainEnglish: Lets the Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District sell up to $321 million in bonds for school facility repairs and upgrades. The estimated tax is $30 per $100,000 of assessed value per year, expected through fiscal year 2056-57.
alreadyFilled.yes: A yes vote allows the District to issue and sell up to $321,000,000 in general obligation bonds, financed by an annual property tax.
alreadyFilled.no: A no vote is a vote against issuing the proposed bonds.
